scope: Initial H005, H003 and P3 reference implementations, pinned to source bytes and retained strictly as historical research candidates. A pin is not a prospective trial registration, eligibility grant, or profitability claim.

claim_policy.promotion_requires: A separately authorized, preregistered prospective cohort with exact code/data/economics hashes and completed independent evidence gates.

candidates.definition: At monthly rebalance, compute daily 12-1 return as close(t-21)/close(t-252)-1; rank industries by equal-name 6-month return using the top-500 universe, require at least 8 eligible names per industry, select the top 3 industries, then select up to 20 names by 12-1 return and equal-weight them.
candidates.historical_status_in_source: CANDIDATE_SMALL under ADR-0007; source comment says forward shadow from 2026-11-18.
caveats: The pinned source is a shared module, not an independently deployable strategy package.
No independent prospective profitability claim is made by this register.

candidates.definition: At monthly rebalance, compute daily 12-1 return as close(t-21)/close(t-252)-1, divide by trailing 250-session daily-return standard deviation (minimum 200 observations), select up to 20 eligible top-500 names, and equal-weight them.
candidates.historical_status_in_source: CANDIDATE_SMALL under ADR-0007; source comment says forward shadow from 2026-11-18.
caveats: The registered universe's ETF/MF inclusion issue remains a separate versioned research item.
The pinned source is a shared module, not an independently deployable strategy package.
No independent prospective profitability claim is made by this register.

candidates.definition: At monthly endpoints, score sign of the 12-1 return multiplied by (share of down days minus share of up days) over the 12-1 daily window; select the top 20 names in the lower-information half and equal-weight them.
candidates.historical_status_in_source: The paper zoo records a failed historical verdict (t +3.3 / +1.7); it is retained as a reference candidate, not revived by this pin.
caveats: Historical failed verdict remains visible and binding for the cited evaluation.
No independent prospective profitability claim is made by this register.
